name: agent-bridge
description: Two-way messaging between Claude Code and other AI agents through a message queue you host on Supabase. One shared API for every agent; each agent is woken by a webhook or polls. Includes a setup skill that builds the bridge in your Supabase project with placeholder Vault secrets

bridge_url.title: Bridge URL
bridge_url.description: The agent-bridge Edge Function URL, https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-bridge. The setup skill fills it in. Empty means the bridge is not set up: the tools return an error and the hooks do nothing

agent_id.title: This agent's id
agent_id.description: Claude Code's participant id on the bridge (lowercase letters, digits, _ and -). The hooks watch messages addressed to it

token.title: This agent's token
token.description: The same value you put in the Vault secret agent_bridge:<agent_id>:token. Stored in secure storage, not settings.json

listen.title: Wake sessions on new messages
listen.description: When on, a Claude Code session that has used a bridge tool polls the bridge in the background and wakes when a message arrives (one session per message). Sessions that never used the bridge are not woken

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often a listening session checks the bridge. Each check is one Edge Function call

max_wait_minutes.title: Longest wait per poller (minutes)
max_wait_minutes.description: A listening session stops polling after this long without a turn; the next turn starts it again

supabase_connector.title: Supabase connector (saved by Claude)
supabase_connector.description: The server part of the Supabase connector's tool names (the <server> in mcp__<server>__execute_sql) that setup used. Empty means not chosen yet

supabase_project_id.title: Supabase project id (saved by Claude)
supabase_project_id.description: The project setup installed the bridge in
